title: HA Climate
addressHint: The URL you open Home Assistant at, such as http://homeassistant.local:8123.
tokenHint: Create a long-lived access token at the bottom of your Home Assistant profile. It is kept in the system keychain.
entityHint: The climate entity the panel controls.
connectedTo: {count, plural, =0 {Connected, but no climate entities were found} one {Connected, # climate entity} other {Connected, # climate entities}}
setupBody: Enter your Home Assistant address and an access token, then choose an air conditioner.
unauthorized: Home Assistant rejected the access token.
requestError: Home Assistant could not be reached.
secretError: The access token could not be stored in the keychain.
trayError: The menu bar icon could not be created.
